browser.screenshot_note: screenshots show what the page displayed; the platform TaskRef/attempt/release and the receipts above are the authority (a screenshot never replaces a receipt)

findings.after: the frozen task-id shape and the `sub` namespace are published identifier shapes; a random opaque run is still redacted
findings.before: acp_services.entrypoints.machine_output._PUBLIC_IDENTIFIER_RE did not know the platform task-id shape, so a real id (YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_NNN_<name>, longer than the 32-char opaque-token net) was rewritten to <redacted> in acp_status; the MCP read could not name the task the CLI and the Workbench named
findings.found_by: the same-TaskRef leg (CLI vs MCP vs Workbench)
findings.title: the MCP status read redacted the TaskRef id

findings.disposition: recorded as a limitation, not fixed here: activating the envelope path for the other workflows is a separate C02/M2 checkpoint
findings.observed: `singlepoint` ran the envelope entry with release 910ca9d3aff95737; `optimize`, `frequency` and `xtb_optimize` ran `entry=legacy` with no release and no execution_receipt.json (execution_chain.DEFAULT_ENVELOPE_WORKFLOWS = {singlepoint})
findings.title: only `singlepoint` writes a release/attempt receipt

findings.disposition: the science leg declares `resources.nproc = 4` in the submit body, so the frozen job spec states exactly what ran; no science value was changed
findings.found_by: repeating the science leg under a test session
findings.observed: with the host default `%pal nprocs 20`, ORCA 6.1.1 aborted in GUESS/SHARK (`Failed to read data of OrcaObject`) whenever the machine's free memory dropped; the same input succeeded with a declared `nproc 4`
findings.title: ORCA's shared-memory startup is memory-sensitive at the host default

findings.disposition: the leg passes `--run-root <isolated root>` explicitly and records the asymmetry; changing the CLI entry is a separate checkpoint
findings.observed: `task query --controller` reads the Controller, but `task export` resolves the job from the local store and reads RESULT/result_manifest.json from the work dir; with only `--controller` it answered `failed` (`--job or --task-dir required`)
findings.title: `acp task export --controller` still reads the local store

findings.disposition: recorded; the client-side builder is a C-line item
findings.observed: `acp2.evidence.report.v1` is a client shape with no producer outside the DSH demo; the M4-01 chain therefore projects the platform facts (digest-bound science report + M1-03 projection + platform decision) and annotates the projection, while the Supervisor still validates the document before using it as advice input
findings.title: no shipped DSH builder for the experience EvidenceReport
